title: I'm making a toy-themed RTS — here's a 1v1 against another player
author: Unboxed_RTS
selftext:
Hey everyone! I'm the solo dev behind Unboxed, a toy-themed RTS I'm building for the browser.

Here's a 1v1 match showing the game in action. I've included roughly the first 3 minutes, so you can get a feel for the gameplay, economy, and unit control.

The game has multiple factions, including Military, Robots, Knights, Classics, Animals, and Space. It's still in development, and I'm working on improving the factions and overall presentation.

I'm using AI-assisted coding during development, while handling the game design and directing the project myself.

You can check out the alpha here:  
[https://discord.gg/d9pG9sFC](https://discord.gg/d9pG9sFC)

I'd love to hear what you think! Especially interested in feedback from RTS players on the gameplay, unit control, and what you'd like to see improved.
